summary: NextNRG, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a stock purchase agreement with CEO Michael D. Farkas. The company issued 260,000 shares at $0.386 per share, totaling $100,360, in lieu of cash payment by extinguishing a promissory note of equal amount owed to Mr. Farkas. The note, dated March 7, 2024, was terminated upon issuance. This is a routine capital transaction with an insider, not a special situation; the filing also reports termination of a material definitive agreement. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor is noted. The transaction is straightforward debt-to-equity conversion with no market impact or regulatory conditions. The filing does not trigger a special-situation classification.
